summary: Websoft9 is a GitOps-driven hosting platform designed for cloud and home servers. It facilitates the single-click deployment of over two hundred open source applications.
goodFor: Users who want to manage multiple open source applications on a single server without manual configuration for each service.
watchOut: The platform relies on shell scripts and Python under the hood, which may complicate debugging when underlying automation scripts fail.
deployNotes: You will typically need to ensure persistent storage volumes are configured for the managed applications and set up a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
